purpose: Test whether deeper frozen execution states correspond to non-decreasing realized episode quality without changing R2.4.

cohort_definition.CORE_REACHED: resolved episodes with core_time present; DERISK remains CORE_REACHED

primary_test.rule: For every adjacent eligible reached-state comparison, later-state mean_terminal_R must be >= earlier-state mean_terminal_R.
primary_test.minimum_n_source: Reuse frozen cycle_bucket_min_n=10; do not introduce a new sample-size threshold.
primary_test.directional_comparisons: Evaluate LONG and SHORT when both adjacent cohorts have n>=10; otherwise report N/A rather than fail.
primary_test.overall_pass_rule: PASS only if both ALL comparisons are eligible and pass, and every eligible LONG/SHORT comparison also passes.

secondary_tests_not_used_for_primary_pas.positive_outcome_rate: Report whether positive terminal-R rate is non-decreasing.
secondary_tests_not_used_for_primary_pas.structural_stop_rate: Report whether STRUCTURAL_STOP rate is non-increasing.
secondary_tests_not_used_for_primary_pas.risk_add_leg_quality: Optional/report-only if clean leg-level reconstruction is available.
